Claim 1 (Currently amended): The ophthalmic illumination system of claim 1, further comprising: a first power monitor operable to receive at least a portion of the first light beam exiting the first attenuator, the first power monitor operable to generate a signal corresponding to the intensity of the first light beam; and a second power monitor operable to receive at least a portion of the second light beam exiting the second attenuator, the second power monitor operable to generate a signal corresponding to the intensity of the second light beam, wherein the control unit is further operable to adjust the first attenuator and the second attenuator based on the signals generated by the first and second power monitors.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The ophthalmic illumination system of claim 1, wherein: the first optical fiber is integrated with a first surgical instrument connected to the first port, the first surgical instrument having a first identifier operable to store and transmit data specific to the first surgical instrument; the second optical fiber is integrated with a second surgical instrument connected to the second port, the second surgical instrument having a second identifier operable to store and transmit data specific to the second surgical instrument, and wherein the first surgical instrument and the second surgical instrument each comprise one of a sclerotomy cannula, a vitreous cutter, an illumination probe, forceps, scissors, a spatula, and a pic, with the first and second identifiers being distinct from the surgical instruments.
